model: The House of the Dead light gun
source: hotd-lightgun.glb: made by the project from a photo of the real Sega gun with an image-to-3D tool
changes: the blue (player 2) gun: the hammer moved onto the slide, a slot with stray slivers behind the cylinder plugged, the pieces welded, cut to 150,000 triangles shaded with the original surface's normals, colours from its texture moved to the blue of a photo of a real blue gun (its light taken out with a photo of a red one), a trigger made for it (tools/cabinet/gun_trigger.py: a curved blade) in the empty guard as part 1, 26 cm long, placed so the hands hold its grip
